purpose: supplementary reproducible candidate retrieval; not original historical search

queries.name: TMF_PFAS
queries.query: ("trophic magnification" OR TMF) AND (PFAS OR PFOS OR PFOA OR perfluor*)

queries.name: BAF_PFAS_field
queries.query: (bioaccumulation OR BAF OR "biota-sediment") AND (PFAS OR PFOS OR PFOA OR perfluor*) AND ("food web" OR field OR wild)

queries.name: BCF_PFAS_fish
queries.query: (BCF OR bioconcentration) AND (PFAS OR PFOS OR PFOA OR perfluor*) AND (fish OR carp OR trout OR zebrafish)

queries.name: PFAS_Arctic_foodweb
queries.query: (PFAS OR PFOS OR perfluor*) AND Arctic AND (food web OR trophic)

queries.name: PFAS_Baltic
queries.query: (PFAS OR PFOS OR perfluor*) AND Baltic AND (food web OR trophic OR biomagnification)

queries.name: PFAS_marine_mammal
queries.query: (PFAS OR PFOS OR perfluor*) AND (marine mammal OR cetacean OR seal OR dolphin OR whale)
